text: Resolved after owner approval 2026-11-18: WHO postpartum prophylaxis after birth (10 units IM or diluted slow IV), suprapubic upward uterine counter-traction by a trained clinician, and intact-cord somersault when feasible before last-resort clamp/cut. Source nodes, drug regimen and summary were corrected before re-extracting this card. Independent AI-assisted source review is not physician signoff.

Seven tiles do not replace assessment of imminence/presentation, equipment preparation, laceration assessment, hemorrhage treatment, or continued maternal/newborn monitoring. Newborn assessment and maternal prophylaxis occur in parallel; do not wait for clamping or APGAR timers.

The compact card directs somersault when feasible but does not reproduce the full maneuver or last-resort clamp/cut technique. Open the source node for the detailed maneuver; suspected shoulder dystocia requires its dedicated emergency pathway.
